summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine board and committee changes. Olaf Koch will join as a non-executive director, subject to shareholder approval at the 2026 AGM; Maria Amparo Moraleda Martinez will retire after nine years; and Christine Ramon and Anne-Françoise Nesmes will become committee chairs. This is a normal governance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, activist campaign, or strategic review is involved. The filing is a foreign private issuer report on routine management changes.
